I recommend this game, but with a caveat. ONLY because it's cheap. 
If there were a "Meh" option instead of yes or no Id've chosen it.

For the price you pay it's..alright.  I love roguelites  and this is certainly one with an interesting concept and a lot of love from the developers.

Unfortunately it can REALLY drag on, taking upwards of 5 hours just to aquire a 3rd character from a roster of that looks to be over 10.  Bear in mind I had the second character unlocked in about 15 minutes, so going another 4 hours without even a hint of one was...disappointing.

The game feels much too slow, unrewarding and even for a roguelite so very repetitive.  Your characters are incredibly sluggish (or at least the two I unlocked), but it has some marvelous mechanics and features that leave me teetering on whether or not this game is really worth it.

Now having said all that and mentioning earlier the unique mechanics.  You're on a timer system, the longer you take the stronger and more frequent enemies become, however you also need to aquire items and level up or it simply wont matter.  Fantastic in theory, not quite well executed.

By the time you've hit the 4th or 5th level even the weakest enemy will take you over a minute to kill throwing everything you have at it.  So just avoid them you may state?  Not optional, you MUST kill everything to ascend to the next stage for one, every single level has a boss that is already spongy as all hell and thirdly you need the money they drop to upgrade any feature of your character.  

It just feels like a spongy grind-fest on a timer late game instead of an entertaining rpg adventure.  Perhaps if they were to give you more variety to the characters before playing for 5 straight hours they could keep you invested, but I'm quite tired of a dodge-roll commando or a smoke-cloud bandit.
